from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    row_modes=[]
    for row in grid:
        c=Counter(row)
        row_modes.append(c.most_common(1)[0][0])
    candidates=[]
    for color in set(row_modes):
        inds=[i for i,x in enumerate(row_modes) if x==color]
        if len(inds)>=3 and len(set(b-a for a,b in zip(inds,inds[1:])))==1 and inds[1]-inds[0]>1:
            candidates.append((len(inds),inds[1]-inds[0],color,inds))
    if not candidates:
        raise ValueError(('no periodic', row_modes))
    _,_,line,rows=max(candidates)
    cols=[]
    for j in range(w):
        c=Counter(grid[i][j] for i in range(h))
        if c.most_common(1)[0][0]==line:
            cols.append(j)
    marks=[(ri,cj) for ri,r in enumerate(rows) for cj,c in enumerate(cols) if grid[r][c]!=line]
    if not marks: raise ValueError('no markers')
    rlo=min(ri for ri,cj in marks); rhi=max(ri for ri,cj in marks)
    clo=min(cj for ri,cj in marks); chi=max(cj for ri,cj in marks)
    colors=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x!=line)
    fill=colors.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[]
    for rr in range(rlo,rhi):
        row=[]
        for cc in range(clo,chi):
            a=grid[rows[rr]][cols[cc]]; b=grid[rows[rr]][cols[cc+1]]
            c=grid[rows[rr+1]][cols[cc]]; d=grid[rows[rr+1]][cols[cc+1]]
            row.append(a if a==b==c==d and a!=line else fill)
        out.append(row)
    return out

def parse_demo(text,n):
 import re
 pat=rf'Demo pair {n} input \(\d+x\d+\):\n(.*?)\nDemo pair {n} output \(\d+x\d+\):\n(.*?)(?:\n\nSame instance|\Z)'
 m=re.search(pat,text,re.S)
 print('match',bool(m))
 inp=[[int(z) for z in line.split()] for line in m.group(1).strip().splitlines()]
 out=[[int(z) for z in line.split()] for line in m.group(2).strip().splitlines()]
 return inp,out
pairs=[parse_demo(users[n],n) for n in range(1,4)]
for k,(g,target) in enumerate(pairs,1):
 try:
  got=transform(g)
  print(k, len(got),len(got[0]),got==target, got, target)
 except Exception as e: print(k,type(e),e)

def transform(grid):
    row_modes = [Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] for row in grid]
    candidates = []
    for color in set(row_modes):
        indices = [i for i, value in enumerate(row_modes) if value == color]
        gaps = {b - a for a, b in zip(indices, indices[1:])}
        if len(indices) >= 3 and len(gaps) == 1 and next(iter(gaps)) > 1:
            candidates.append((len(indices), color, indices))
    _, line_color, line_rows = max(candidates)

    line_cols = []
    for col in range(len(grid[0])):
        if Counter(row[col] for row in grid).most_common(1)[0][0] == line_color:
            line_cols.append(col)

    marked = [(ri, ci) for ri, row in enumerate(line_rows)
              for ci, col in enumerate(line_cols)
              if grid[row][col] != line_color]
    r0 = min(ri for ri, _ in marked)
    r1 = max(ri for ri, _ in marked)
    c0 = min(ci for _, ci in marked)
    c1 = max(ci for _, ci in marked)
    fill_color = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row
                         if value != line_color).most_common(1)[0][0]

    output = []
    for ri in range(r0, r1):
        out_row = []
        for ci in range(c0, c1):
            a = grid[line_rows[ri]][line_cols[ci]]
            b = grid[line_rows[ri]][line_cols[ci + 1]]
            c = grid[line_rows[ri + 1]][line_cols[ci]]
            d = grid[line_rows[ri + 1]][line_cols[ci + 1]]
